features.heading: Everything for the cards you collect
features.subheading: Search, build, track, and trade  one place for your whole Yu-Gi-Oh! collection.

search.title: Search cards
search.body: A fast, full card search engine  every set, rarity, and printing at your fingertips.

decks.title: Decks
decks.body: Build decks from scratch or import a list  see exactly what you own and what you need.

piles.title: Wishlist & trade pile
piles.body: Two lists: the cards you're hunting, and the ones you'll part with. Every match on the site comes from comparing them.

trade.title: Trade
trade.body: Add cards to your trade pile and wishlist  we surface mutual matches for direct, one-for-one trades.

tradeShowcase.heading: One card for one card
tradeShowcase.body: When your trade pile holds a card on someone's wishlist  and they hold one on yours  One for One flags the mutual match. No money, no bidding. Just a fair, direct swap.

people.heading: People are already here
people.subheading: Real accounts, real trade piles. Every name below links to what they have up for trade.

discord.heading: Trade straight from Discord
discord.body: Post a card in our Discord and it shows up on the site in seconds. Find mutual matches, chat with collectors in real time, and never miss a drop.

bullets.sync: Post in the server, it syncs to the site
bullets.chat: Chat with collectors in real time
bullets.alerts: Be first to hear about drops & events

plan.heading: Run a shop, a Discord, or a local group?
plan.body: Put it on the map. Verified communities are the ones collectors find when they search near them, and the only ones that can post events.
plan.monthly: Or {month} a month, with six months free. Cancel any time.

donate.heading: Keep One for One free
donate.body: One for One is built and run by one person, with no fees and no ads. If it saves you time, a small tip helps cover the servers and keeps every feature free for everyone.

communityVerify.discordTokenExpired: That Discord session expired before we could check. Start again.
